cases.title: Machine shaft attachment
cases.criteria: The crank meets the shaft with readable scale, orientation and contact.
cases.context: Whole machine and neighbouring parts, plus a side view of the connection.

cases.title: Turning free shafts
cases.criteria: A standalone crank visibly drives an exposed shaft.
cases.context: Show the crank, entire shaft and intended player action together.

cases.title: Cogwheel drive
cases.criteria: Both connected cogs turn with clear contact and rotation direction.
cases.context: Final proof needs a clip showing the complete drive through a full turn.
